response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS site_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.site_count) AS average_site_count, AVG(sr.rate - o.average_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sr.rate > o.average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A zero scan duration is excluded from rate calculations because file size per minute is undefined for it.
